speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a concerning rash and recent health changes; can you describe exactly where the rash started and what it looks like? When did these symptoms first begin, and have you had any fever or weight loss recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. The new cough and arthritis management raise concern for a systemic issue; are you currently taking any new medications, and did the rash appear shortly after starting them? Also, have you noticed any joint pain, joint swelling, or fatigue alongside this rash?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Liver Function Tests, and Eosinophil Count. REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology photos of the back and oral mucosa.
